notes.title: Action! 4.43.0 with critical fixes for Windows 11 24H2 update is now available!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

First of all we are sorry for any problems you might have had with Action! after upgrading to the latest 24H2 Windows 11 version. This update is very big and changes a lot in Windows architecture (that's why there are words it should be called Windows 12). 

Most of the Windows 11 display core has changed and the desktop no longer uses a "swap chain" presentation model. Instead Direct Display is now used and allows direct rendering of desktops with any framerate to the display devices. Also multiplane overlays are now used on all supporting hardware (you can check for MPO3 support in Dxdiag application for you GPU).

Some of you may know what Multiplane overlays are and what headache they can cause (including game flickering/crashing etc.). Since there is no official information on how to disable MPO in the system (there was a magic registry key but it is not working anymore) we are going to provide a small app called MPOOFF that can disable Multiplane Overlays deep in the system. It will be available for download on our Remotly product website remotly.com soon (on the community page).

How Multiplane overlays work? In short these are hardware accelerated graphics/video planes that are composed using special hardware offloading GPU 3D core. In the past this composing was done in DWM (Desktop Window Manager) using 3D shaders, sharing processing power with 3D apps and games.

Below please find all fixes for 24H2 included in version 4.43.0:

- Fixed HUD in desktop mode (fix for Windows 11 24H2 update)
- Fixed automatic HDR detection for games (fix for Windows 11 24H2 update)

notes.title: Action! 4.17.0 with OriSound™ function is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6003958/67f78b2ca1d5e86cc67edf486702a8ae6544c5c1.png[/img]

Dear users,

In version 4.17.0 we are introducing OriSound™, a long-awaited feature that allows to record audio exclusively from selected games and applications!

This feature has been requested by hundreds of users that needed to use second PC or specialized headphones to split main audio track and voice chat sound. 

These times are over. You no longer need to waste your money on additional hardware.

You can select your favorite voice chat application (like Discord) and record it into separate audio track that will not be mixed with main game audio track!

Additionally the sound you record will never be modified by sound card post-processing so you always get original volume, pitch and tone.

It will also not get disturbed by random system "blips" comming from popup windows etc.

HOW TO USE ORISOUND™:
1. Use "Selected application" from audio device list (either primary, secondary or aux device).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6003958/5766eea5fbf3cd64e26f1ac1d68262101896d5f1.png[/img]

2. A window will appear showing currently detected sound sources in the system (from system audio mixer).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6003958/f7b49a84131831536d17d8c44cf81f5dad3c2133.png[/img]

3. If the application you want record sound from is not running or is not visible on the list you can use the '+' button to select its exe file (you need to manually find its location first).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6003958/25e61e40262669f70d95aff883193cefe8b5f23a.png[/img]

NOTES: This feature might not work for anti-cheat protected games and some games with spatial audio like Dolby Atmos. This will be added soon in version 4.18.0.

Other changes in version 4.17.0:
[list]
[*] Fixed CS:GO with Nvidia SLI enabled
[*] Support for duplicated monitors has been fixed
[*] Improved downmix of multi-channel audio to stereo
[*] Fixed HDR10 recording on AMD GPUs with latest AMD drivers installed
[*] Added fullscreen mode to JPEG XL viewer
[*] Stability fixes
[/list]
We are also working hard on Action 5 and Action 4.18.0 that will add support for Kernel Proxy Audio recording and integration of Vulkan layer with Action core libraries that will fix Action Vulkan layer interoperability with anti-cheat protected games.
